title: Product A: Adverse Reactions
shortdesc: Summary of clinical trial and post-marketing adverse reactions observed with Product A.

sections.content:
The following adverse reactions occurred in ≥ 10% of patients receiving Product A in clinical trials:
Neutropenia | 68% | 32%
Fatigue | 54% | 8%
Nausea and Vomiting | 42% | 4%
Thrombocytopenia | 28% | 12%

Clinically significant adverse reactions requiring medical intervention or dosage modification include:
- Febrile Neutropenia: Occurred in 5% of patients. Discontinue treatment immediately and initiate broad-spectrum anti-infectives.
- Hepatotoxicity: Elevated transaminases (ALT/AST > 5x ULN) observed in 3% of patients. Dose interruption or reduction required.
- Infusion-Related Reactions: Severe hypersensitivity occurred in 2% of patients during initial infusion.
